meta.title: Delete Articles
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Delete Articles".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Delete Articles', 'joomlaguide-delete-articles', '

In this tour you delete an article. In Joomla that takes two stages: first you move the article to the trash, then you remove it from the trash for good.

First you create the article to delete: Retired Announcement in the category News.

This tour follows the tutorial 5.2 Delete Articles from the Articles List of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 5.2 Delete Articles from the Articles List', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Create an article to delete', '

Click New.

', 3, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-new', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Title', '

Type the title:

Retired Announcement

Then click Next.

', 4, 'bottom', '.view-article #jform_title', 2, 2, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Category', '

Choose the category News.

Leave Status at Published. Then click Next.

', 5, 'left', '.view-article fieldset.form-vertical:has(#jform_catid)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Article text', '

Type the text, for example:

This announcement is no longer relevant and can be safely removed.

Then click Next.

', 6, 'right', '.view-article fieldset.adminform:has(#jform_articletext)', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 7, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Select the article', '

Tick the checkbox in front of Retired Announcement.

This enables the Actions button in the toolbar. Then click Next.

', 8, 'right', '.view-articles #articleList tr:has(a[title$="Retired Announcement"]) input[name="cid[]"]', 2, 5, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Actions', '

Click Actions.

', 9, 'bottom', '.view-articles .button-status-group', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Move it to the trash', '

Click Trash.

', 10, 'right', '.view-articles #status-group-children-trash .button-trash', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Find trashed articles', '

Joomla confirms that the article is trashed, and it is gone from the list: this list does not show trashed articles.

To see them, click Filter Options.

', 11, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-btn-filter', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Show the trash', '

In - Select Status -, choose Trashed.

The list shows the trashed articles, including Retired Announcement. A trashed article can be restored or deleted for good. Then click Next.

', 12, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"-2"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Restore the article', '

Click the trash icon in the Status column of Retired Announcement.

The article is published again and disappears from the list of trashed articles.

', 13, 'right', '.view-articles:has(#filter_published option[value="-2"][selected]) #articleList tr:has(a[title$="Retired Announcement"]) .article-status button', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Find the article again', '

Now you delete the article for good. First move it to the trash again.

In - Select Status -, choose Published. Then click Next.

', 14, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Select the article', '

Tick the checkbox in front of Retired Announcement. Then click Next.

', 15, 'right', '.view-articles:has(#filter_published option[value="1"][selected]) #articleList tr:has(a[title$="Retired Announcement"]) input[name="cid[]"]', 2, 5, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Actions', '

Click Actions.

', 16, 'bottom', '.view-articles:has(#filter_published option[value="1"][selected]) .button-status-group', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Move it to the trash', '

Click Trash.

', 17, 'right', '.view-articles:has(#filter_published option[value="1"][selected]) #status-group-children-trash .button-trash', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Show the trash', '

In - Select Status -, choose Trashed. Then click Next.

', 18, 'bottom', '.view-articles #filter_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"-2"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Select the trashed article', '

Tick the checkbox in front of Retired Announcement.

In the trash, the toolbar has a Delete button. Then click Next.

', 19, 'right', '.view-articles:has(#filter_published option[value="-2"][selected]) #articleList tr:has(a[title$="Retired Announcement"]) input[name="cid[]"]', 2, 5, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Delete for good', '

Click Delete.

Joomla asks whether you are sure: click Yes. The article is deleted permanently.

', 20, 'bottom', '.view-articles #toolbar-delete .button-delete', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Back to the list', '

Click Clear, next to Filter Options, to return to the normal list of articles.

', 21, 'bottom', '.view-articles .js-stools-btn-clear', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-delete-articles'), 'Well done!', '

Retired Announcement is gone for good.

Before you delete an article, think about archiving it instead: an archived article stays available to reuse later.

', 22, 'top', '#articleList', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
